dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline along the trailing edge, exhibiting a deep falcate curvature from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a minimal pixel radius, forming a sharp morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, measured at approximately 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Height-dominant silhouette with a base-width-to-vertical-height ratio of approximately 0.85:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, moderate-radius convex curve defining the dorsal-anterior melon boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent light caustic patterns (refractive light ribbons) distributed across the dorsal-lateral integument.
